title: 表单填空
goal: 按栏目预测答案，并提取符合词数与单位要求的原词或数字。

points.label: 按栏目判断所需信息类别
提取符合栏目和字数限制的答案

sources.title: 雅思 IELTS Academic：课表
sources.used: 听力课的内容、知识点与教学规格

body.p: 栏目名决定要填哪一类信息。Surname 填姓氏，Contact number 填号码，Start date 填开始日期。预测只定类别，具体答案要从录音中听。

body.box:
Surname: ___
Contact number: ___
Start date: ___
Fee: £___ per person
Requirement: ___

body.p: 答案从录音中提取，填多少看空前和空后已给的词。Fee: £___ 已有货币符号，只填数字。Requirement: ___ room 只填房间类型，不再写 room。

steps.d: 根据栏目名和已给内容预测信息。Contact number 后面填号码，不填相邻的地址。
看清限的是几个词、几个数字。ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER 可以写 9 July，不能写 the ninth of July。
保留区分对象的修饰词。录音说租的是 electric bicycle 时，只写 bicycle 分不出普通车和电动车。
把答案放回栏目，检查有没有重复或填错栏。Cost: £___ per day 只填金额，不再加 pounds per day。

cards.title: 栏目与答案类别
rows: My first name's Hana and my surname's West. → West
分清电话和地址。号码按听到的顺序写。
Phone: zero seven three, four one, six two → 0734162
分清申请、开始和结束日期，只填栏目问的那个。
Apply on 4 June; start on 12 June. → 12 June
看币种和费用对应的项目，已给的单位不再写。
保留必要的修饰词，空后已给的词不再写。
a quiet room; Required: ___ room → quiet

body.box:
A: I'd like to register for the craft fair. My surname is Vale.
B: What space does the stall need?
A: A covered pitch, please. I can bring my own table.
B: The fee is twenty-four pounds. The fair is on 16 August, but payment is due on 8 August.

Craft fair registration
Surname: ___ (ONE WORD)
Pitch type: ___ (NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS)
Fee: £___ (A NUMBER)
Event date: ___ (ONE WORD AND A NUMBER)

body.p: 姓氏栏填 Vale。摊位类型填 covered pitch，covered 表示有遮盖的场地。费用栏已有 £，填 24。活动日期填 16 August，8 August 是付款期限。

body.box:
A: The equipment is for a portable radio, not a television.
B: I'll record that.
Item: ___ (NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS)
Answer: portable radio

body.p: 填原词要保留 portable，不能只写 radio，也不能换成同义词。如果题面已给 Item: portable ___，空内只填 radio。

cards.title: 干扰项
rows: 场地类型要写出 covered，只写 pitch 不完整。
8 August 属于付款期限，活动是 16 August。
portable 已给，空内只填 radio。
题目要求填原词，不能换成同义词。

lines.text: The dog's name is Pepper. The owner's surname is Grant.
I'll use Grant in the owner's record.

items.stem: Owner's surname: ___ . Write ONE WORD from the recording.
items.why: owner's surname is Grant 说的是主人的姓，Pepper 是狗的名字。

lines.text: For the collection, should I use the shop address?
No, please use my mobile number: zero seven one, two four, eight six.

items.stem: Contact number: ___ . Write the digits only, without spaces.
items.why: mobile number 后逐位给出 0712486，题面要求数字连续书写。

lines.text: What kind of gloves does the sewing kit include?
Cotton gloves. The leather gloves are sold separately.

items.stem: Included gloves: ___ . Write ONE WORD from the recording.
items.why: 套装里的是 Cotton gloves，gloves 已给，只填 cotton。leather 手套另售。

lines.text: Is delivery nine pounds?
That's the packing charge. Delivery is fourteen pounds.

items.stem: Delivery charge: £___ . Write A NUMBER in digits.
items.why: Delivery is fourteen pounds，£ 已给，填 14。9 镑是包装费。

lines.text: I'm calling about a stall at the village book exchange. I mainly have children's books, so I'd like a low table if possible.

There's a low table available near the window. The exchange takes place on the twenty-third of September, and stallholders can arrive early to arrange their books. The ordinary visitor entrance is at the front, but stallholders use the side door.
That's suitable. My surname is Holt. Is there a charge for the table?
It's seven pounds for the day. A chair is included, and extra chairs cost two pounds each.
One chair is enough. Please reserve the low table for me.
I've recorded the surname Holt and the table request. Pay at the side door on arrival.

items.stem: Surname: ___ . Write ONE WORD from the recording.
items.why: My surname is Holt 给出了姓氏，填 Holt。

items.stem: Table type: ___ . Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the recording.
items.why: Please reserve the low table 确认类型，low 不能省略。

items.stem: Table charge: £___ for the day. Write A NUMBER in digits.
items.why: seven pounds for the day 是桌位费用；2 是额外椅子的价格。

groups.text:
Book exchange stall
Surname: ___
Table type: ___
Table charge: £___ for the day

lines.text: Hello, I'm arranging delivery of a large plant from the garden shop. My first name is Ellis and my surname is Brook. The order was placed yesterday, but I haven't selected the delivery details.
Certainly, Ellis. Is the delivery going to the address on the order, and what sort of container has been chosen?
The address is correct. I'd like a ceramic pot, rather than the plastic one shown in the photograph. The plant is a gift, so the container matters.
We can provide that. Delivery costs sixteen pounds, while the ceramic pot is twenty-eight pounds. The plant itself has already been paid for.
That's fine. Please deliver it on Tuesday afternoon. I work in the morning, so nobody will be there before lunch.
I've recorded Tuesday afternoon. The driver will ring before arriving, using the contact number already on the order.
Good. There's a narrow passage beside the house, but the front door is wide enough for the pot.
I'll add a note asking the driver to use the front door.

items.stem: Surname: ___ . Write ONE WORD from the recording.
items.why: my surname is Brook 对应姓氏，Ellis 是名字。

items.stem: Container type: ___ . Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the recording.
items.why: I'd like a ceramic pot 给出了容器，填 ceramic pot。plastic 是照片里的款式，没有选。

items.stem: Delivery charge: £___ . Write A NUMBER in digits.
items.why: Delivery costs sixteen pounds 对应配送费，28 是花盆费用。

groups.text:
Plant delivery form
Surname: ___
Delivery address: as on order
Contact number: as on order
Container type: ___
Delivery charge: £___
Delivery period: Tuesday afternoon

lines.text: Good morning. I'm applying to join the neighbourhood tool library. I submitted my details online, but the form asked me to telephone about the starting date and the equipment I need.
I can see the application here. The name is Tessa Lane, and the contact number is already recorded. Would membership from the first of November be suitable?
I won't be moving into the area until later. Could it start on the ninth of November instead? I need tools for putting up shelves in my new flat.
Yes, the ninth of November is available. The membership fee is thirty pounds, and there's a separate refundable equipment deposit. What would be the first item required?
An electric drill. I have a hammer already, and I can borrow a ladder from a neighbour. How should I confirm the application?
Bring a signed form to the counter. An unsigned copy can't be accepted. The address and telephone number don't need to be submitted again.
I'll bring the signed form and collect the drill when membership starts.

items.stem: Membership start date: ___ . Write ONE WORD AND A NUMBER, with the day before the full month name.
items.why: the ninth of November is available 确认了开始日期。the first of November 是最初的提议。

items.stem: First item required: ___ . Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the recording.
items.why: 第一件要用的工具是 An electric drill，electric 要保留。hammer 已有，ladder 向邻居借。

items.stem: Document required at the counter: ___ . Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the recording.
items.why: Bring a signed form 给出了所需文件。下一句说不收 unsigned copy，所以 signed 不能省。
